note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Four screens in Teams and the Power Automate portal, each in the browser profile of the user named in account. Request numbers (#NN) are the lab list's real IDs.
prepare: # owner signs in: browser profiles (InPrivate is fine) for labadmin (make.powerautomate.com), sam.demo, riley.demo and alex.demo (Teams on the web). Nothing is typed or stored here.

# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 1-4): Workflows app already allowed in the Teams admin center; team IT On-call (owner labadmin; members Sam Demo, Riley Demo, Taylor Demo) with the standard channel On-call; AssignedTo person column on IT Requests; solution IT On-call (ITOnCall) with the four environment variables (IDs never on screen)

# owner (demo.md Setup 5, 7): flow 'IT on-call dispatch' turned on, plus the PT5M lab copy (original off while recording the timeout path); as alex.demo create the High requests 'Laptop won't boot before a client demo', 'VPN drops every 10 minutes' and 'Shared printer offline before payroll'

screens.name: card
steps: Open the team 'IT On-call' and the channel 'On-call'
Show the Workflows (Flow bot) card 'High priority IT request #NN': facts Category Hardware, Raised by Alex Demo, Raised at, the note box
Show the buttons Take it, Need more info and Open the request; do not answer yet
mask: tenant name in the title bar and the profile menu
team ID and channel ID in links
any account that is not a lab user

screens.name: taken
steps: Press Take it on the card as Sam Demo
Show the card replaced by 'Request #NN has been picked up. Who took it is posted in this channel.'
Show the message '@Sam Demo took high priority request #NN: Laptop won't boot before a client demo' with Sam highlighted as a mention
Insert: open the IT Requests item in SharePoint and show Assigned to = Sam Demo
mask: tenant name in the title bar, profile menu and SharePoint URL
team ID and channel ID in links

screens.name: timeout
steps: Open the run history of the PT5M lab copy of 'IT on-call dispatch' and the run of 'Shared printer offline before payroll'
Show 'Ask on-call' timed out, 'Route response' skipped, 'Escalate to lead' green (Mention lead, Escalate in channel, Record escalation), 'Dispatch done' green and the run Succeeded
Insert: in Teams show the channel message '@Taylor Demo nobody has taken high priority request #NN in 30 minutes'
mask: environment ID in the address bar
team ID and channel ID in the run inputs
user object IDs in the responder object

screens.name: chat
steps: Open the Workflows (Flow bot) 1:1 chat of Alex Demo
Show 'On-call needs more information about your IT request #NN VPN drops every 10 minutes:'
Show Riley Demo's note 'Office or home network?'
Show 'Please add it to the request or reply to Riley Demo.'
mask: tenant name in the title bar and the profile menu
any account that is not a lab user

teardown: # owner (tenant): turn both flows off (original and the PT5M copy) and delete the copy; delete the test requests and the test channel messages; keep the team for later episodes or delete it
